TITLE: Song Sheet for a Broken Neon Sign
TEXT:
SONG SHEET — NEON SIGN (one light missing)

Verse 1:
WE  LC  ME
WE  LC  ME
half the word still shines,
half the word becomes a question.

Chorus:
F L I C K E R
F L I C K E R
like a thought that refuses to behave.

Verse 2:
OPEN
OPEN
unless you are cruel.

Bridge:
If you read me in the rain,
I will stutter you into believing
something can be repaired
without being replaced.
